AccountIdentifications = accountProfile.Identifiers
                .Where(identifier =>
                    identifier.AccountIdentificationType is not ProfileKeys.Details
                        .BaseAccountNumber)
                .Select(identifier =>
                    new AsyncAPI.AccountIdentifications
                    {
                        AccountIdentificationType =
                            GetAccountIdentificationType(identifier.AccountIdentificationType),
                        AccountIdentification = identifier.AccountIdentification
                    })
                .ToList()
